Proving a storage slot is usually done in 3 steps: * From the stateRoot of a block, process the account proof (see `eth_getProof`) to get the account details. * RLP decode the account details to extract the storageRoot. * Use storageRoot of that account to process the storageProof (again, see `eth_getProof`).
